instruction: Please set Chrome to display 100 tabs per row in the tab bar instead of the default behavior. I have many tabs open and would like to see more tabs at once without scrolling horizontally.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide a setting to control the number of tabs displayed per row. The tab bar automatically adjusts based on window width and tab count, with no user-configurable option for tabs per row.
